# AgendaBurn Blog

> Articles on what meetings cost, why most of them should be writing instead, and how AgendaBurn calculates the burn.

The blog's canonical host is https://blog.agendaburn.com/. The product is https://agendaburn.com/.

## Articles

- [All articles](https://blog.agendaburn.com/): The blog homepage
- [$37 Billion Wasted on Meetings: Is Your Company Guilty?](https://blog.agendaburn.com/37-billion-wasted-on-meetings-is-your-company-guilty/): The $37 billion estimate and how to tell if a company is part of it
- [Async-First Manifesto: Replace 71% of Meetings with Docs](https://blog.agendaburn.com/async-first-manifesto-replace-71-of-meetings-with-docs/): A written-first replacement for status meetings
- [How Much Does a Meeting Cost Your Company?](https://blog.agendaburn.com/how-much-does-a-meeting-cost-your-company/): Hourly cost math for a team in the room
- [Meeting Cost Calculator: How Much Is Your Stand-Up?](https://blog.agendaburn.com/meeting-cost-calculator-how-much-is-your-stand-up/): What a recurring stand-up costs
- [Why Most Meetings Are Useless (And Cost You Millions)](https://blog.agendaburn.com/why-most-meetings-are-useless-and-cost-you-millions/): Why status meetings fail and what to do instead

## Product

- [AgendaBurn](https://agendaburn.com/): The meeting cost calculator
- [Open the calculator](https://agendaburn.com/app): Live timer
